_doc: Public document register and substantive change history, newest version first. Only versions with published: true appear on the public page (study.html 'Document history'); until one is published that section is omitted. The newest version number is printed in the PDF header (render.py b_document_version), so changing it regenerates the PDF. While the newest version is unpublished, its 'status' is printed after it (b_document_status), for example 'Version 4 · 23 September 2026 · Draft for review': a status such as 'Draft for review', never an instruction to the reader. Once that version is published, no status is printed. The status of older versions is never rendered.
